Title / Título: Type the amount on the sliders, or make + jump to the maximum / Escribir la cantidad en las barras, o que «+» salte al máximo
What it asks / Qué pide: The + and − buttons on the mechanics, race strategy, VIP and engineer screens move the bar one step at a time. The proposal is a box where you type the amount or, at the very least, a + that goes straight to the maximum.
Status / Estado: To see later / A ver más adelante

Title / Título: Top drivers should not end up at minor teams / Los pilotos top no deberían acabar en equipos menores
What it asks / Qué pide: Top drivers such as Häkkinen or Schumacher should not sign for teams like Minardi or Tyrrell.

Title / Título: No test-driver deals that make no sense / Nada de fichajes de probador que no tienen sentido
What it asks / Qué pide: A driver like Eddie Irvine should not suddenly sign as a test driver for a team such as Sauber.

Title / Título: Effectively permanent contracts / Contratos prácticamente permanentes
What it asks / Qué pide: Some deals should be practically permanent, for example Ferrari always using Ferrari engines.

Title / Título: Live championship standings during the race / Clasificación del campeonato en vivo durante la carrera
What it asks / Qué pide: A screen with the Drivers' and Constructors' championships that updates as positions change, to see at a glance how the current race affects both.

Title / Título: Optional refuelling ban, with the AI pitting by tyre wear / Prohibir el repostaje como opción, con la IA parando por desgaste
What it asks / Qué pide: An option to abolish refuelling and make the AI pit according to tyre wear. It should be modular: mods set in the 90s and 00s keep refuelling, and mods set in the 10s and 20s do not.

Title / Título: Suppliers: Cash Rating first, and a preference for the own-name supplier / Proveedores: primero el Cash Rating, y preferencia por el que lleva su nombre
What it asks / Qué pide: Teams should choose suppliers by their Cash Rating rather than their R&D rating, and prefer the supplier that carries their own name (Ferrari engines for Ferrari).

Title / Título: A team trait for tyres / Un rasgo de equipo para los neumáticos
What it asks / Qué pide: A team trait such as "prefers good wet-weather tyres", so that a team goes for Goodyear first. With engines the choice is simpler; with tyres it needs a trait like this.

Title / Título: Attributes from 1 to 10 instead of 1 to 5 / Atributos de 1 a 10 en lugar de 1 a 5
What it asks / Qué pide: Replace the 1–5 scale of attributes with 1–10, to tell drivers and staff apart better. The bars in the interface are the obstacle; one idea is to split one bar in two. Traits and favourite tracks would complement it…

Title / Título: Drivers should weigh much more in pace / Los pilotos deberían pesar mucho más en el ritmo
What it asks / Qué pide: In the dry, drivers hardly make a difference. The proposal is that Speed, from 1 to 5, should add up to a gap of around two seconds of pace, with variance inside that range. A driver a little below the best would be a 3…

Title / Título: Rework next season's car handling / Rehacer el handling del coche de la temporada siguiente
What it asks / Qué pide: Change how next season's car handling is calculated: make each skill point worth more, add a bigger random part, and add a part based on last season's standing or the team's prestige.

Title / Título: Traits and favourite circuits for drivers / Rasgos y circuitos favoritos para los pilotos
What it asks / Qué pide: Give drivers (and teams) traits and favourite circuits, to tell them apart beyond the 1–5 stars.

Title / Título: Make electronics matter / Que la electrónica importe
What it asks / Qué pide: Electronics feel useless. Today the part only wears out when the driver's orders are changed.

Title / Título: Make driver signing and chief signing checks tougher / Endurecer los controles de fichaje de pilotos y jefes de departamento
What it asks / Qué pide: There are already checks in place for when a team tries to sign a driver or department chief and the team isn't competitive (say, their estimated budget is low, WCC position is bad).

Title / Título: Remove Sponsor royalty % / Quitar el % de royalties de patrocinio
What it asks / Qué pide: Remove Sponsor royalty % contract for commercial director OR change it so that it reflects the skill (5 bar comm director asks for 5% max, 2 bar asks for 2% max).

Title / Título: Better use of "Driver Orders" by the drivers of other teams. / Mejor uso de las "Driver Orders" por los pilotos de otros equipos.

Title / Título: sub mods / Submods
What it asks / Qué pide: Once a semi-working version of 1998 is implemented, ask the AI to make sub mods for other years (i'd love the 2001-adapted version).
